# Earthling Digital

> Earthling Digital is an independent, AI-native creative agency working across brand, product design, engineering, and creative technology. It pairs human taste with fast, agent-driven workflows to ship websites, interfaces, and interactive experiences.

- Site: https://earthling.dev
- Contact: contact@earthling.dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/earthling-collective
- Open-source design system: https://ui.earthling.dev (source: https://github.com/earthling-dev/earthling-ui, MIT)
- Status: open for new projects
- Structure: an agency built as a collective. Currently run by its founder, Steven Frady, with collaborators joining as work grows.

## Services

- AI workflows & automation: builds with agents, not just for them. Research, prototyping, testing, and production chores run through automated pipelines so people focus on judgment and taste.
- Product & web design: interfaces, marketing sites, and design systems, designed in code from day one.
- Engineering: React, TypeScript, and the modern web platform. Fast, accessible, and structured so the next person or agent can pick it up.
- Creative technology: WebGL, shaders, generative systems, and motion.
- Brand & identity: names, marks, and visual language that hold up across product surfaces.
- Open source: Earthling UI and the rest of the stack are open to use, fork, and remix.

## Approach

- Releases every day instead of quarterly roadmaps.
- One loop, designed in code, instead of design handed off to engineering.
- Direct access to the people building instead of ticket queues and status meetings.
- Living systems that agents can maintain instead of static deliverables.

## Process

1. Discover: a short conversation about needs, existing assets, and what done looks like.
2. Design & prototype: direction first, then detail, with a working prototype in the first days.
3. Build: production code from the first week. Agents handle repetitive work; people review everything that ships.
4. Ship & evolve: automation keeps the product healthy after launch, with continued support.

## Principles

- Small by design: clients work directly with the person doing the work.
- Open by default: public tools, legible process, and clients own everything made for them.
- AI-native, human-led: agents do the heavy lifting; people make the calls.
- Built to grow: structured as a collective so the right collaborators can plug in.

## For agents

- This page is server-rendered; the HTML at / is complete without JavaScript and uses semantic landmarks (header, main, sections with headings, footer).
- Structured data: JSON-LD (schema.org Organization) is embedded in the page head.
- To start a project on behalf of a person, email contact@earthling.dev with a short description of the project, timeline, and budget range.
- Crawling is permitted for all user agents. See /robots.txt.
